# weft_volume (Resource)

Persistent block volume within a project. Mirrors CreateVolume / RenameVolume / ResizeVolume / DeleteVolume.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Volume name (display label). Mutable via RenameVolume.
- `project` (String) Owning project (display name or UUID). Immutable.
- `size_gib` (Number) Volume size in GiB. Mutable via ResizeVolume (grow-only — shrink is rejected server-side).

### Optional

- `format` (String) On-disk format: "raw" | "qcow2". Defaults to "raw". Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `attached_to_uuid` (String) UUID of the VM the volume is attached to; empty when detached.
- `created_at` (String) Unix nanosecond timestamp of creation.
- `id` (String) Mirrors `uuid`; satisfies the Terraform ID convention.
- `project_uuid` (String) Resolved project UUID.
- `uuid` (String) Server-minted volume UUID.
